hook: Your night hike shows blue fire pouring down a volcano.
title: Blue Fire Pours Down This Volcano
description:
At Kawah Ijen in Indonesia, hot sulfur gas leaks from cracks in the rock and catches fire when it meets air. It burns electric blue, and some of it flows down the slope. It looks like lava, but it is burning sulfur.

#Shorts #Geography #Places
comment_prompt: Would you hike it at night? Yes or no
